coding_questions.title: String Palindrome Check
coding_questions.description: Given a string S, check whether it is a palindrome. Ignore spaces and case differences.

coding_questions.title: Array Rotation
coding_questions.description: Given an integer array arr of size N and a number D, rotate the array to the left by D positions.

coding_questions.title: Prime Number in a Range
coding_questions.description: Given two integers L and R, return all prime numbers in the inclusive range [L, R].

coding_questions.title: Fibonacci Term Calculation
coding_questions.description: Given an integer N, find the N-th term of the Fibonacci sequence (0-indexed: F(0)=0, F(1)=1, F(2)=1, etc.).

coding_questions.title: Count Vowels and Consonants
coding_questions.description: Given a string S, return the count of vowels and consonants as an array [vowels_count, consonants_count].
